messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: RStan installation error on linux cluster
parts:
On Wednesday, December 10, 2014 1:16:43 PM UTC-5, Cameron Bracken wrote:
Any Ideas?

Check to make sure you are not running over your quota on disk space in your home directory. Also, what compiler is mpicxx? We have not tested anything with that.

Ben

messages.author: 115bcf2cc8b220a2
messages.subject: Re: RStan installation error on linux cluster
parts:
On Wednesday, December 10, 2014 1:29:14 PM UTC-7, Ben Goodrich wrote:
On Wednesday, December 10, 2014 1:16:43 PM UTC-5, Cameron Bracken wrote:
Any Ideas?

Check to make sure you are not running over your quota on disk space in your home directory. Also, what compiler is mpicxx? We have not tested anything with that.

Ben

Good call! I was running into my disk quota in my home directory, should have checked that. Everything works great now. 

Thanks! 

P.S. mpicxx is the mpi c++ compiler, just a wrapper for g++, and should have no effect in the case of stan where no mpi directives are used
